title: France 'very unhelpful': Trump lashes out at allies
summary: President Donald Trump expressed frustration Tuesday with allies who have been unwilling to do more to support the US war effort, telling them to “go get your own oil” as the conflict with Iran and its closure of the Strait of Hormuz sent average US gas prices past $4 a gallon. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Rochelle Ferguson Bouyahi tells us more.
